name: braxis
description: Extract AI-ready context from Python projects: authority patterns, architectural constraints, code generation, multi-variant patterns, agent policies, and monorepo structure.
author: jaykrishna316

patterns.authority: Extract product guarantees, state contracts, mutation constraints
patterns.constraints: Detect architectural constraints and critical rules
patterns.codegen: Identify code generation providers and ownership maps
patterns.multivariant: Find sync/async twins, platform clients, auth patterns
patterns.policy: Extract agent contribution policies and sentiment
patterns.monorepo: Analyze monorepo structure and per-package guidance

tools.name: analyze_repository
tools.description: Analyze a repository and extract all AI context patterns

tools.name: extract_patterns
tools.description: Extract specific pattern types from a repository

tools.name: generate_agents_md
tools.description: Generate AGENTS.md context file for AI agents

tools.name: get_readiness_score
tools.description: Get AI readiness score for a repository

installation.github: git clone https://github.com/jaykrishna316/braxis && cd braxis && pip install -e .

screenshots.name: Extract Authority Patterns
screenshots.description: Detect product guarantees and state contracts

screenshots.name: Analyze Code Generation
screenshots.description: Identify generated files and provider types

features: 🧠 Extract Authority Patterns - Product guarantees, state contracts, mutation constraints
🏗️ Architectural Constraints - Detect breaking changes, critical rules, sync requirements
🔧 Code Generation - Identify Stainless, OpenAPI, Protobuf, and other providers
👥 Multi-Variant Patterns - Find sync/async twins, platform clients, auth patterns
🤖 Agent Policies - Extract contribution policies and sentiment (friendly/restricted/cautious)
📦 Monorepo Analysis - Detect structure and per-package Python versions/guidance
📝 AGENTS.md Generation - Auto-generate context files for AI agents
